# Excluded Vorbis evaluation copy

Unmodified [stb_vorbis.c](https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20/stb_vorbis.c) 1.22 by Sean Barrett and contributors, pinned in UPSTREAM.json. Reviewed 2026-10-04.

The evaluation used the MIT alternative in LICENSE, compatible with GPLv3. Original source notices are preserved. This copy is excluded from Meson, application binaries and portable licence bundles. VibeStudio's active Vorbis decoder uses Xiph libvorbis/libogg; see docs/DEPENDENCIES.md and docs/CREDITS.md.

This prototype was not selected after decoder verification and upstream review. It remains as an excluded evaluation copy pending filesystem cleanup; it establishes no supported application format or runtime dependency. UPSTREAM.json records its original source hashes.
